changeSet.author: lifefit
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0086. Record each personal-training collection separately from the assignment balance. Index review: PK on MemberPtPayments.Id; IX_MemberPtPayments_TenantId_MemberPtAssignmentId_PaymentDate for the member payments list. No extra unique index because several collections can share a day. Performance note: the list index leads with TenantId and covers one assignment.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.MemberPtPayments ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MemberProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MemberPtAssignmentId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Amount DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL, Currency NVARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, PaymentMethod NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, PaymentDate DATE NOT NULL, ReferenceNumber NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Notes NVARCHAR(2000) NULL, Status NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, ReceivedByUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_MemberPtPayments PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtPayments_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtPayments_MemberProfiles FOREIGN KEY (MemberProfileId) REFERENCES app.MemberProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtPayments_MemberPtAssignments FOREIGN KEY (MemberPtAssignmentId) REFERENCES app.MemberPtAssignments (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtPayments_ReceivedByUsers FOREIGN KEY (ReceivedByUserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtPayments_Amount CHECK (Amount > 0), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtPayments_Status CHECK (Status = N'Posted'), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtPayments_PaymentMethod CHECK (PaymentMethod IN (N'Cash', N'Upi', N'DebitCard', N'CreditCard', N'BankTransfer', N'OnlinePayment', N'Cheque', N'Other')) ); CREATE INDEX IX_MemberPtPayments_TenantId_MemberPtAssignmentId_PaymentDate ON app.MemberPtPayments (TenantId, MemberPtAssignmentId, PaymentDate DESC) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
